summary: Format a Node path object with Node field-precedence and extension-dot rules.

requirements.path_object: object semantics available; relevant fields read with normal JS property access
requirements.path_flavor: default host, posix, or win32 is statically known

target.notes: Property reads may invoke getters before the helper can format; preserve JS evaluation/property-access semantics.

semantics.precedence: dir overrides root; base overrides name and ext
semantics.extension: when base is absent, a missing leading dot is added to non-empty ext in modern Node

caveats: Dynamic getters/proxies on the path object must be handled by ordinary object-property semantics before/within the compatibility layer.
